title: Angelo Torres
description: "The STAR WARS movies continue to be big favorites, to be seen over and over again in my house," says Angelo Torres. "The imaginative gadgetry still amazes me, so it was fun to be able to draw the Walker." Torres served in Korea and upon being discharged in 1953 attended the Cartoonists and Illustrators School (SVA now). Besides comics, he's worked in advertising, magazine illustration and children's books. He's also been with MAD MAGAZINE since 1968 and is relatively sane.
